SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_address_businesses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_address_businesses
FROM biz_addr ba
JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id

SELECT CONCAT(p.frst_nm, ' ', p.lst_nm) AS sales_person, t.nm AS territory
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN prsn p ON sp.ref2 = p.ref1
JOIN sls_terr t ON sp.ref1 = t.trrt_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'
SELECT DISTINCT v.nm FROM vnd v JOIN prod_vnd pv ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2 JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref3 WHERE p.nm = 'Women''s Tights'
SELECT MAX(bm_lvl) FROM bom WHERE ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, SUM(sod.ordr_qty) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(sod.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
JOIN prod p ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN so_dtl sod ON sod.ref2 = p.prdc_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so_hdr.sls_ordr_id)
FROM so_hdr
JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id
JOIN sls_terr ON cust.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN cnty ON sls_terr.ref1 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd
WHERE cnty.nm = 'Canada'
  AND YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013
SELECT p.nm FROM prod p WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM so_dtl d WHERE d.ref2 = p.prdc_id)

SELECT SUM(so_dtl.ln_ttl)
FROM so_dtl
JOIN so_hdr ON so_dtl.ref3 = so_hdr.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod ON so_dtl.ref2 = prod.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ON prod.ref2 = prod_sub.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat ON prod_sub.ref1 = prod_cat.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE prod_cat.nm = 'Bikes'
  AND YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013
